published_figures.description: GCT separates claims by epistemic status, from the single Tier 0 first-person datum through Tier 1 axioms to Tier 4 exploratory extensions, so foundational certainty cannot leak into downstream hypotheses.

The ontological root has two axioms; the current gauge/lepton architecture adds declared postulates P1-P5 and continuous anchors A1-A6, with a named six-item Tier-3 precision/gauge coefficient subset and the O.38 N=144 cage posit counted separately from other categorized handles and closure targets.

The core accounting currently uses five postulates plus six anchors for the gauge, lepton, native-RGE endpoint, and precision-comparison sector, while broader hadronic, biological, and cosmological sectors retain additional calibrated inputs.
Numerical matches are sorted by provenance before interpretation: postdictions, predictions, tensions, sensitivity-limited rows, and registered FAIL rows have different evidential meanings.
Epistemic descent from the founding axioms down to observable quantities: each layer inherits the assumptions of the layer above, and numerical rows retain their epistemic tier labels.

The divergence of information density: classical smooth spacetime (left) demands unbounded degrees of freedom under successive zoom, whereas GCT discrete quantum geometry (right) saturates at the lattice spacing, supplying a built-in cutoff.

The Zero-Point Schism: the self-differentiation $0 = (+1) + (-1)$ shown as a symmetric bifurcation of the void into Subject and Object, with the global sum conserved at zero. Existence as the internal differentiation of Nullity.

The Wheeler-DeWitt null constraint: the global state satisfies $\hat{H}|\Psi\rangle = 0$, so the universe carries no external time parameter, and temporal flow is modelled as the internal correlation structure of the static block; no physical Selection clock, biology-to-vacuum source, or phenomenal bridge is inferred.

A chosen cylinder-tree presentation on a selected profinite transversal. Finite nodes are coarse cylinders, infinite nested ends determine transversal residue addresses, and the level-zero root is the whole transversal $C_{0,0} = \widehat{\mathbb{Z}}$ rather than the connected Solenoid, a primordial point, or a subject. A full Solenoid point additionally carries its suspension coordinate. The highlighted end marks address membership only; it is not an Agent.

A localized transverse phason profile whose healing length is identified, at Tier 3, with $\xi = a_0/\alpha \approx 7.25$ nm (Tier 1 arithmetic) has diameter $2\xi \approx 14.5$ nm, comparable to the microtubule lumen diameter near 15 nm as a Tier 3 substrate correlation; this is a numerical coincidence noted for orientation, not a derived match.

Conditional simultaneous-aperture model: several physical apertures coexist at distinct coordinates of a static spacetime block, while an added incidence map—not Solenoid topology alone—assigns them to a declared parent identity sector. Ownership and cross-aperture experience remain separate Tier 3/4 bridges.

The emergence of relational time (Page-Wootters mechanism): the static Wheeler-DeWitt block decomposes into clock states and correlated system states, and the ordered sequence of conditional system states supplies a relational time label with no external time parameter. Horizontal axis: formal ordinal update index (not a derived Zeno clock); vertical axis: configuration-space amplitude of the system state. Identifying the conditional sequence with an Agent's phenomenal time requires transition, memory, owner, and phenomenal bridges.

The graded Quality Space under $I_h$: the symmetric $6\times 6$ stress tensor (quadratic sector) decomposes as $2A_g \oplus G_g \oplus 3H_g$ (21 DOF, no 3-D irrep), while the coordinate space $\mathbb{R}^6$ (linear sector) carries the two 3-D irreps $T_1\,(E_\parallel) \oplus T_2\,(E_\perp)$ (6 DOF); modality labels are Tier 3.
DMC compares nuclear-spin and chirality candidate controls; neither leg is necessary or sufficient for Level II, and Level II remains open (Tier 3) for every substrate.

A conditional Trp radical-pair material model shows singlet/triplet dynamics and a hypothetical protected subspace whose preparation and leakage suppression remain unestablished; it carries no phason, Selection, Polaron, or Level-II inference.

Comparison figure: a golden-ratio two-dimensional projection of the 240 E8 roots, with the six primitive hypercubic directions of the adopted $\mathbb{Z}^6$ overlaid for comparison. The overlay is not a sublattice relation: $D_6\subset\mathbb{Z}^6$, and $\mathbb{Z}^6$ has norm-1 vectors and does not embed in the even lattice $E_8$ (§1.2.1). The inner twelve-neighbor coordination maps to the icosahedral signature of the physical projection. Tier 1 projection geometry; Tier 1/2 architectural reading

The cut-and-project construction: a two-dimensional square lattice stands in for the $\mathbb{Z}^6$ parent. Lattice points whose perpendicular projection falls within the acceptance strip $W$ project onto the physical line $E_\parallel$ (slope $\tan\theta = 1/\phi$), yielding an aperiodic Fibonacci sequence of long and short intervals; the discarded coordinates form the internal sink $E_\perp$.

Gravity as a phason elasticity gradient: an undeformed lattice in flat, massless space (left) develops a strain-magnitude gradient $|\nabla u_\perp|$ around a mass (centre), warping the lattice (right). The lower panels contrast metric curvature in General Relativity with the internal phason torsion of the GCT extension, picturing the elastic restoring force on a displaced test particle as the gravitational attraction. Tier 3 analogy: $G$ is not fixed by the phason stiffness (§8.1.4; App DPS §DPS.7)

Conditional Tier 3 elastic-response ansatz shown log-log: $a = a_N$ at high accelerations and the assumed deep-elastic limit $a = \sqrt{a_0 a_N}$ at low accelerations, joined by an RAR interpolation. The empirical $a_0 = 1.2\times10^{-10}\ {\rm m\,s^{-2}}$ is distinct from the dimensional thermodynamic scale $cH_0 = 6.54832237\times10^{-10}\ {\rm m\,s^{-2}}$; the Tier 3 candidate $cH_0/(2\pi) = 1.04219787\times10^{-10}\ {\rm m\,s^{-2}}$ is 13.1502% low, and neither its coefficient nor the physical normalization is derived.

Dark-energy equation of state $w(z)$: the stipulated biogenic no-crossing template stays at or below the $\Lambda$CDM boundary $w = -1$ for all plotted redshifts, asymptoting to $-1$ from below, while the representative DESI CPL fit (with its uncertainty band) shows a phantom crossing in the CPL parametrisation of the data (the crossing in the CPL fit to the GCT curve is a fit artifact). The $z \sim 0.28$ marker is a distinguishability point, not a physical crossing; the inset resolves the registered Class-2 envelope. Tier 3

The Planck-SH0ES $H_0$ gap is about 8.4 percent, while the excluded broad-logistic comparison has the wrong sign: the linear-max plus Planck diagnostic is 0.254314 percent of the observed tension. The balanced TRGB and JAGB anchors are reported in the surrounding text.

In the $w_0$-$w_a$ plane, the DES-Dovekie + CMB + DESI DR2 CPL target sits in the sign-opposite quadrant relative to the registered GCT biogenic channel menu. The logistic reference pair $(-1.0038,+0.0136)$ is a non-operative broad-logistic reference, not a GCT prediction.

Conditional gauge lift (Tier 3): 6D icosahedral lattice strain is mapped to the 4D electromagnetic field tensor $F_{\mu\nu}$; in this proposal the photon is identified with the transverse phason vector mode, massless under unbroken $U(1)$ protection and spin-1 by construction of the assumed gauge action.

Opposite-charge phase vortices in the superfluid order parameter: the $U(1)$ phase winds by $+2\pi$ and $-2\pi$ around the two cores, with the wrapped phase field and its gradient flow illustrating quantized winding number, which GCT proposes (Tier 3) as the topological origin of electric charge.

Standard spatial-rotation control: the SU(2) double cover sends a $2\pi$ rotation to the central element $-1$, while a $4\pi$ rotation returns to $+1$. Applying this control to a GCT defect requires its physical framed bundle; the internal weak-isospin bundle is separate.

The ten three-fold axes of the rhombic-triacontahedral window: quadrupole Gram rank 6 (the maximum for any ten axes), traceless-seed span 5, and an eight-dimensional closure with the $A_2/\mathfrak{su}(3)$ fingerprint. Generic ten-axis sets reproduce the same closure, so the color identification is an open Tier 3 candidate.
The electroweak boundary problem: the Tier 3 H-EW boundary is separated from the measured Z-pole value, and the two current flow routes miss the endpoint.

Conditional Higgs completion: once a continuous doublet target and broken-vacuum coefficients are added, the standard Mexican-hat potential supplies the usual symmetric and broken phases. The literal lattice action does not select the sign or vacuum radius, and the zero configuration remains admissible.
The electron Planck-link audit follows $\phi^{-18} \to \phi^{-108} \to \phi^{-107}$ and drag factor $(1-5\alpha)$, while O.14 physical-link closure remains open.
Electron, muon, and tau masses sit on a log axis with $N=11$ and $N=17$ harmonic overlays; correction-stage residuals and row-specific Protocol B gates are shown separately.

Registered GCT candidate $\Sigma m_\nu = 0.0853 \pm 0.0003$ eV (a consistency scale from the Tier 3 floor plus measured oscillation gaps); current DESI/CMB $\Lambda$CDM bounds are tension bands, while the registered hard gates are $<0.075$ eV or $>0.15$ eV at definitive precision.

The quark mass spectrum is shown against declared PDG comparison conventions; the down-quark row P.20 sits inside its registered 11% band, with the $m_d = m_u\phi^{\phi}$ closed form a Tier 3 identification of the finite-cage median, conditional on O.5.

Conditional on the Tier 3 O.38 cage posit, the 3.55 keV X-ray centroid is modeled as a narrow Lorentzian over the cluster continuum (the line width is an open programme, §11.2.3); the Tier 3 fracture hypothesis also motivates a candidate feature in the cluster lensing shear profile.

Protocol A-Prime is decided by a frequency-resolved, chirality-dependent $T_2(\nu_d)$ pattern: Branch A, Branch B, and chirality contrast feed the three-conjunct joint null; the 150 MHz point is a mechanism diagnostic.

The microtubule cross-section as a candidate lumen geometry: thirteen protofilaments enclose the central lumen with Tryptophan sites in the lumen wall, shown as possible radical-pair and coherence probes. The potential-well depiction is a Tier 3 scenario; no phason coupling, Zeno-gating condition or Identity-Polaron realization is inferred.

Protocol D compares active-state $T_2$ in matched H$_2{}^{17}$O and H$_2{}^{16}$O preparations; the registered sign-positive material-proxy branch assigns positive $\Delta T_2$, while standard BPP relaxation predicts the opposite sign; the P.13c gate is held pending redesign, so no outcome currently supports or rejects the branch, and neither sign is a GCT, phason or Level-II verdict.

Registered outcome roadmap: the neutrino-mass band, the 3.55 keV line shape and the dark-energy phantom-phase distinguishability carry physics-sector decision rules; the historical THz material-emission proxy has no decisive GCT or consciousness gate.

Under the WP2025 high-HVP synthesis, the experiment-theory gap is small while the GCT correction overshoots it; the channel survives only if R-ratio/lattice arbitration reopens a material gap near the GCT offset.
